source_methods.path_mapping: explicit absolute POSIX --remote-readout-root mapped onto local --readback-root without rewriting receipt bodies
source_methods.geometry_clock: rational timestamps must equal original j/25; no shift/stretch/interpolation
source_methods.fixed_phase: old RMS-only three-seed official-offset median p; curves use absolute lags [-8,...,+8] at original center j
source_methods.primary_endpoints: Cp=C(p); Hp=C(p)-mean(C(p-4),C(p+4)); p is not used to shift the 17-point support window
source_methods.normalization: each arm own mean/population SD over frames jointly tracking-valid in all three arms and inside original natural duration
source_methods.aggregation: frame mean per frozen S17 token, equal tokens per exact basephone, equal basephones per high/low class

cells.lag_coordinates: absolute frame offsets [-8,...,+8] at each unchanged S17 center j; no p-shifted window
cells.aggregation: token mean over original S17 core; equal token means per exact basephone; equal basephones per high/low class
